articles.summary: PulteGroup, Inc. (NYSE: PHM) today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, October 22, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call to discuss its third quarter results that same day at 8:30 a.m. (ET). A live audio webcast of the call will be available on PulteGroup’s website. To listen to the webcast, log on five minutes prior to the call at www.pultegroup.com and select the Events Presentations link under the Investor tab. For call participants, the dial-in number is (833) 461-5787 (conference ID 150962034). The call will be recorded and available for audio replay within 24 hours. articles.summary: More than nine out of ten PulteGroup employees say the company is a great place to work, according to the latest Great Place To Work ® survey. Based on employee feedback, PulteGroup, Inc. (NYSE: PHM), America's third-largest homebuilding company, has earned Great Place To Work Certification™ for the eighth time . This year, 92% of employees said PulteGroup is a great place to work, compared with 57% at a typical U.S. company. "A leadership team doesn’t win awards like this. They're earned by thousands of people who choose every day to support one another, serve our customers, and uphold our values," said Ryan Marshall, President and CEO of PulteGroup. "That's what has defined PulteGroup for generations, and it's what gives me confidence in where we're headed." articles.title: PulteGroup Earns 2026-2027 Great Place To Work Certification™

articles.summary: Launch of new Florida Panhandle Division supports company’s continued growth amid strong demand statewide PulteGroup, one of the nation's largest homebuilders, is expanding its operations into Northwest Florida and launching a new Florida Panhandle Division to support those efforts, the company announced today. The expansion positions the company for growth as it continues to see strong demand for new homes across Florida. PulteGroup is naming Taylor Larza as Vice President and Market Manager for the new division. "Florida continues to be one of PulteGroup’s strongest markets, and our expansion into Northwest Florida and launch of the Florida Panhandle Division reflects the significant growth potential we see in that region," said Rich McCormick, PulteGroup's Southeast Area President.
